name: AccessiMate
author: bdplugins

sections.description:
AccessiMate is a powerful WordPress accessibility plugin designed to help website owners make their sites more accessible to users with disabilities. It provides a comprehensive set of tools and features to ensure your website meets WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines and complies with accessibility standards.

Key Features

  • Accessibility Toolbar: A customizable frontend toolbar with accessibility options
  • High Contrast Mode: Toggle high contrast colors for better visibility
  • Font Size Controls: Allow users to increase or decrease font sizes
  • Enhanced Focus Indicators: Improve keyboard navigation visibility
  • Skip Links: Add skip-to-content links for keyboard users
  • Link Highlighting: Highlight all links on the page for better visibility
  • Text-to-Speech: AI-powered text-to-speech functionality
  • Content Scanning: AI-powered accessibility scanning and suggestions
  • Text Simplification: AI-powered text simplification for easier reading
  • Alt Text Generation: AI-powered alt text generation for images

AI-Powered Features

AccessiMate includes advanced AI features powered by OpenAI and Google Vision:

  • Automatic Alt Text: Generate descriptive alt text for images
  • Content Analysis: Scan content for accessibility issues
  • Text Simplification: Provide simplified versions of complex text
  • Speech Synthesis: Convert text to speech with natural voices

Accessibility Standards

  • WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
  • Section 508 compliance
  • ADA compliance
  • EN 301 549 compliance

User-Friendly

  • Easy-to-use admin interface
  • Customizable toolbar positions
  • User preference persistence
  • Responsive design
  • Translation ready

Privacy Policy

AccessiMate respects user privacy:

  • User accessibility preferences are stored locally in your database
  • AI features (when enabled) may send content to third-party services (OpenAI/Google)
  • No personal data is collected or transmitted without user consent
  • Session data is used only for preference persistence

Third-Party Services

This plugin may connect to the following third-party services when AI features are enabled:

  • OpenAI API: For GPT-4 Vision alt text generation and text processing

    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy/
    • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/terms/

  • Google Vision API: For image analysis and alt text generation

    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://cloud.google.com/terms/

These connections are only made when:
1. AI features are enabled in settings
2. Valid API keys are configured
3. Users actively use AI-powered features

Support

For support, please visit our documentation or contact us through our website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the accessimate folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure the plugin settings under Settings > AccessiMate
  4. (Optional) Add your OpenAI or Google Vision API keys for AI features
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys to use this plugin?

API keys are only required for AI-powered features like automatic alt text generation, content scanning, and text simplification. The basic accessibility features work without any API keys.

Is this plugin WCAG compliant?

Yes, AccessiMate is designed to help your website achieve WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. However, full compliance also depends on your theme and content.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

AccessiMate is optimized for performance. CSS and JavaScript files are only loaded when needed, and the plugin uses efficient caching mechanisms.

Can users save their accessibility preferences?

Yes, user preferences are automatically saved and restored when they return to your website.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, AccessiMate is fully translation ready and includes all necessary translation strings.
